title: Registered session followed by bounded UnconnectedSend
purpose: Reach the nested unconnected explicit-message parser through a registered session while retaining bounded CPF and embedded request lengths for mutation-friendly variation.
expected_behavior: The server should establish or reject the session, then parse the SendRRData CPF and either return a normal CIP response or a deterministic protocol error for the nested UnconnectedSend request.
constraints_preserved: registered session identifier reused by SendRRData
CPF item count 2 with Null Address and Unconnected Data items
bounded Unconnected Data length of 14 bytes
embedded CIP request remains fully present within its declared item
issue_safety_notes: Targets the same broad CPF and nested-length parser region as the cited issues without using the reported three-item sockaddr layout, forged path-size values, receive-buffer padding, or historical crash payload.
